name: CHAIN SNARE
text: When an enemy would Fall Back from a Hand of the Archon operative that has no other enemy in its control range, roll 2D6 (one die if the enemy has more Wounds than that operative): on any 4+ the Fall Back is cancelled with no AP spent and Chain Snare is used up for the turning point. A miss costs nothing and it stays ready.

name: WICKED BLADES
text: Every array of blades of your Hand of the Archon operatives has Atk 4.

name: TOXIN COATING
text: Twice per turning point, once a Hand of the Archon operative fighting or retaliating has chosen its melee weapon, the blade can be venomed: Lethal 5+ until the end of that fight. No CP needed.

name: REFINED POISON
text: Twice per turning point, a Hand of the Archon operative firing a shardcarbine, splinter cannon, splinter pistol, splinter rifle or stinger pistol in a Shoot may load refined toxins: +1 Normal Dmg for the rest of the action. No CP needed.
